title: Add total count to v1 pagination metadata while preserving forward-only signed cursors

endpoints.before: `meta.pagination` only returned `{ limit, hasMore, nextCursor }` without a total matching item count.
endpoints.after: `meta.pagination` includes `total` (matching item count cached independently of `limit` and `cursor`, or `null` if unavailable), while preserving forward-only HMAC-signed cursor pagination (`page` and `offset` remain rejected with 400).
